messages.subject: Senior Executive Candidate | Mining, Energy, ESG & External Affairs | International
messages.body:
Dear Recruitment Team,

I am reaching out for confidential consideration for senior international opportunities. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional execution in a major mining environment.

My career spans more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations. I am internationally mobile and interested in Director, Head, Country, External Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Operations and related leadership mandates.

My executive CV is attached. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding suitable opportunities.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
